title: AI-Assisted Cyberattacks Trigger Unauthorized Payments at Indian Banks and Fintech Firms
content_md: The Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) has warned that threat actors are carrying out artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted cyber attacks targeting information and communication technology (ICT) assets in the country. This unsanctioned activity has resulted in unauthorized financial transactions at banking and financial services entities, as well as technology service providers
